items.title: Root npm test self-bootstraps packages/utils via a pretest so the full suite no longer fails when utils/dist is absent
items.context: Add a root pretest that builds both packages/main and packages/utils before full-suite-runner. Prove with a repro-first RED that a bin/lattice.js-dependent path fails via bootstrap-runner when packages/utils/dist is missing, and that the pretest wiring rebuilds utils so it recovers. dist is gitignored so the rebuild will not dirty the tree.
